notes.title: Patch 1.0.7a
notes.content:
-The bug on the prince scene has been fixed. Now, if you didn't watch the whole scene, the menu will be working.

If you find any problem, feel free to report us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/wQJvzpW]Discord[/url] or on the game forum.

Cheers,

H-Room Team

notes.title: Small Patch (Bug on Horny Tower 12F)
notes.content:
- Some people have found a bug on Horny Tower 12F, specifically on the shooting gallery that stops to works. Now, it's fixed. If you have found this bug, leave this floor through the level exit and return to it.

Feel free to report any bugs by joining [url=https://discord.gg/wQJvzpW]Discord[/url] or using the game forum. Also, don't forget to follow my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/h-room]Steam page[/url] to get the latest news!

Cheers,

Pieve

notes.title: The Horny Tower 17F Map and the Guide have been updated
notes.content:
-  The 'Botanical Menace H-scene' was impossible to be unlocked since the map 17F didn't have a free way to reach the Overgrown Lake area. I've already fixed it, so enjoy the scene!
- The map photo from Horny Tower 17F available on the Guide/Walktrough has been updated.

Feel free to report any bugs by joining [url=https://discord.com/invite/wQJvzpW]Discord[/url] or using the game forum. Also, don't forget to follow my Steam page to get the latest news!

Cheers,

Pieve

notes.title: Slime Trouble Side Quest have been fixed
notes.content:
- The Leather Vest was removed as a reward from the Slime Trouble Side Quest. This item is only a reward from the Old Treasure Side Quest.
- Minor bugs and misspelling have been fixed;

Feel free to report any bugs by joining [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] or using the game forum. 

Cheers,

Pieve
